identity_specification: Adult Alice mixed with the Mad Hatter: long golden hair, turquoise eyes, black top hat with teal band and heart card, red bowtie, teal coat over white blouse, blue skirt/apron, mismatched stockings, brown boots, playing cards. No teacup.
actions_specification: Transparent side-view cel-shaded illustrated sheet, 5 columns x 4 rows. Row 1: idle 4 then blank. Row 2: blink open, half-closed, closed, open then blank. Rows 3-4: ten consecutive attack poses: Sweep an arm, fan three glowing cards to the right, cast and recover. Same identity, outfit and camera in every full-body right-facing pose. Transparent gutters; no text, scenery, shadows or grid.
walk_specification: Transparent 4 x 4 sheet, sixteen consecutive in-place right-facing walk poses, alternating legs/arms, matching frame 16 to frame 1. Aladin instead bobs and floats on his carpet. Preserve character design; no grid or text.
preparation: Source PNGs retained. Godot separates silhouettes and packs padded runtime atlases. This JSON records the production prompt specifications.
cleanup_specification: Remove only the horizontal/vertical grid lines and replace them with transparent alpha while preserving all poses and layout.
